consumer: A dialogue/mission eligibility condition asking the engine 'does the avatar possess item c4?' via the engine's own has_item/has_amount possession predicate.
scope: The possession predicate's required reach (the avatar's full possession set as the engine's has_item check defines it, including nested containers), not just a flat on-person wielded/worn/inv enumeration.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items dumps wielded_items()/worn/inv_const_slice() as a flat carried_items[] array — raw item enumeration, not the engine's computed possession verdict.
divergence: A brick of c4 stored inside a worn backpack/container pocket: the engine's has_item(c4) possession predicate returns true, but a consumer re-deriving the answer from the flat carried_items enumeration can miss or mis-scope the nested item.
